client_version_source: Host CLI --version checked after native replay on 2026-11-10; probe used the same CLI installation.

container_resource_observation.scope: Container cgroup high-water marks include setup and helper processes; not server-only RSS or FD peaks.

limitations: Fixture namespace only; host-client and other-tool traffic are not captured.
The production guard rejects encoded responses before decompression. The 8 MiB decoded size is verified offline from captured bytes; the product did not allocate or decode that payload.
Two finite bomb shapes and a 128 MiB cgroup run do not prove arbitrary compression safety or aggregate resource-exhaustion resistance.
This run tested clean install and uninstall; upgrade was not exercised.
Unsigned experimental package is not an owner-approved official candidate.
Independent human review is not claimed; four AI Scraping Defense repositories require separate evidence.

packet_capture.capture_scope: fixture network namespace only; host client network not captured

platform: Debian 12 amd64 container joined to route-free fixture namespace
reproduction: OUTBOUND_GUARD_PACKET_ARCHIVE=PRIVATE_DIR/claude.pcap python3 tools/debian_native_container_probe.py claude PACKAGE.deb PACKAGE_SHA SKILL.zip SKILL_SHA --fixture-mode compressed-bombs-packet --container-memory-mib 128 --sample-server-resources; python3 tools/verify_native_compressed_bomb_pcap.py RETAINED.pcap SHA
scenario: native claude gzip and deflate expansion-bomb denial and approved recovery
